|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure" and r._field == "solarInputPower" )
|> last()

from(bucket: "smarthome")

from(bucket: "smarthome")

|> last()

from(bucket: "smarthome")

|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tasmota" and r._field == "Power")

charge =
from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: -3h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure" and r._field == "outputPackPower")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with joinKey: "x" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "joinKey"])

discharge =
from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: -3h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure" and r._field == "packInputPower")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with joinKey: "x" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "joinKey"])

join(tables: {c: charge, d: discharge}, on: ["joinKey"])
|> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: now(),
    _value: r._value_c - r._value_d
}))

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
|> range(start: today())
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and r._field == "solarInputPower" )
|> last()

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
|> range(start: today())
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and r._field == "green_injected" )
|> last()

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
|> range(start: today())
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and (r._field == "packInputPower" or r._field == "pv_excess") )
|> last()

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
|> range(start: today())
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and r._field == "swm_used" )
|> last()

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "daily_energy" and
    (
      r._field == "solarInputPower" or
      r._field == "outputHomePower"
    )
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _measurement: "solar efficiency",
      _field: "eta",
      _value:
        r.outputHomePower / r.solarInputPower
  }))

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "daily_energy" and
    (
      r._field == "solarInputPower" or
      r._field == "outputHomePower" or
      r._field == "gridInputPower" or
      r._field == "green_upstream"
    )
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _measurement: "solar use ratio",
      _field: "eta",
      _value: (r.outputHomePower + r.green_upstream - r.gridInputPower) / r.solarInputPower
  }))

import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")
from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "tasmota" and r._field == "Power") or (r._measurement =="zendure" and r._field == "outputHomePower"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement: if r._measurement == "zendure" then "0zendure" else r._measurement}))
  |> drop(columns: [ "room", "_start", "_stop", "domain", "electric"])
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )

import "array"

sensors =
  array.from(rows: [
    {_measurement: "fritz", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "mystrom", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "remoteweather", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "smart-manager", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "smarthings", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "tasmota", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "zendure", _value: 0}
  ])

data =
  from(bucket: "smarthome")
    |> range(start: -6m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.domain == "heartbeat")
    |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
    |> count()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _measurement: r._measurement,
        _value: if r._value > 0 then 1 else 0
    }))

union(tables: [sensors, data])
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> max()

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "zendure" and (r._field == "outputHomePower" or r._field == "gridInputPower" ))
                    or (r._measurement == "mystrom" and r.device == "solar" and r._field == "power")
                    )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value:  (if r._field == "gridInputPower" then -1.0 * float(v: r._value) else float(v: r._value)) }) )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
